name: Lookalike Scout
tagline: Name one company you want more of, get a list of the ones like it
description: Start from a single account that fits your market and it fans out to businesses of the same shape, then works out who inside each one would actually sign off on a purchase and confirms those contacts. The roster keeps refreshing rather than sitting there as an export that goes stale in a week.
author: ShehjadTaus
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
